input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips, COUNT(DISTINCT rider) AS riders, MIN(month) AS first_month, MAX(month) AS last_month, SUM(ebike) AS ebike_trips, SUM(duration_min > 45.0) AS over_included, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_min, SUM(duration_min <= 0) AS bad_durations, SUM(duration_min > 1440) AS over_one_day FROM (SELECT rider_id AS rider, month, week_start, duration_min, CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT)) AS mins, (rideable_type LIKE '%electric%') AS ebike, 1.0 + CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.35 ELSE (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 END AS ppu_cost, CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 WHEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) > 45.0 THEN ((CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) - 45.0) * 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS member_residual FROM trips)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rider_months, SUM(n) AS rides, ROUND(SUM(ppu), 2) AS ppu_total, ROUND(SUM(resid), 2) AS member_residual, SUM(10.0 + resid < ppu) AS months_membership_cheaper FROM (SELECT rider, month, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ppu_cost) AS ppu, SUM(member_residual) AS resid FROM (SELECT rider_id AS rider, month, week_start, duration_min, CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT)) AS mins, (rideable_type LIKE '%electric%') AS ebike, 1.0 + CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.35 ELSE (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 END AS ppu_cost, CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 WHEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) > 45.0 THEN ((CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) - 45.0) * 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS member_residual FROM trips) GROUP BY rider, month)

SELECT week_start, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_min, ROUND(SUM(ppu_cost), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend, ROUND(SUM(member_residual), 2) AS member_extra FROM (SELECT rider_id AS rider, month, week_start, duration_min, CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT)) AS mins, (rideable_type LIKE '%electric%') AS ebike, 1.0 + CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.35 ELSE (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 END AS ppu_cost, CASE WHEN rideable_type LIKE '%electric%' THEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) * 0.15 WHEN (CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) > 45.0 THEN ((CAST(duration_min AS INT) + (duration_min > CAST(duration_min AS INT))) - 45.0) * 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS member_residual FROM trips) GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start
